name: Site Incident Report and Follow-Up
description: Staff report incidents at any site. The safety lead classifies severity, serious incidents are escalated immediately to the site manager and safety lead, follow-up actions are tracked to closure, and a permanent record is kept for insurers.

intent.outcome: Every reported site incident is classified for severity within 24 hours, serious incidents are escalated immediately to the site manager and safety lead, all follow-up actions are recorded and closed out, and a complete signed-off incident record is retained for insurer and regulator enquiries. Assumptions made where the description was silent: severity is classified by the safety lead on a four-point scale plus a 'not reportable' outcome; closure is signed off by the site manager; follow-up actions are tracked as a repeating list on the record rather than in a separate tool; records are retained for ten years.
intent.respondents: Any staff member working at or visiting one of our sites

fields.label: Your work email
fields.help: We send you updates on this report here.

fields.label: Which site did this happen at?
Where exactly on site?
fields.help: For example: loading bay 3, mezzanine stairs, yard gate.

constraints.message: Report incidents from the last 90 days. Older events: contact the safety lead directly.

fields.label: What kind of incident was it?
What happened?
fields.help: Describe what you saw, in order. Stick to facts.

fields.label: What was done straight away?
fields.help: For example: area cordoned off, machine isolated, first aider called.

fields.label: Photos of the scene
fields.help: Up to 10 images. Do not photograph anyone's injuries.

fields.label: Name of the person who was hurt
Nature of the injury
fields.help: Body part affected and what kind of harm. Visible only to the safety lead.
fields.collectionReason: Health information required to decide whether the incident is statutorily reportable and to support any insurer or workers' compensation claim. Restricted to the safety lead and never included in emails, documents or webhooks.

fields.label: What treatment was given?
fields.collectionReason: Level of medical treatment determines regulatory reporting thresholds and insurer notification. Restricted to the safety lead and never shared outside the platform.

fields.label: Did anyone else see it happen?
Was property, plant or equipment damaged?
I confirm this report is accurate to the best of my knowledge
Investigation record reference
fields.help: Reference of the investigation file held in the safety folder, so it can be located later without copying it here.

tasks.name: Classify severity and record triage notes
tasks.description: Read the report, set the severity classification, note whether the insurer must be told, and record triage notes. Serious and critical incidents alert the site manager as soon as you complete this.

tasks.name: Investigate the incident and log follow-up actions
tasks.description: Complete the investigation, store the investigation file in the safety folder and record its reference here, then log each follow-up action with an owner and a due date.

tasks.name: Confirm every follow-up action is closed
tasks.description: Chase the action owners, mark each action closed with a completion note, then set 'all follow-up actions are closed' and complete this task.

email.name: Report received
email.subject: We have your incident report from {{site_location}}
email.body:
Hi {{reporter_name}},

Thanks for reporting what happened at {{site_location}} on {{incident_date}}. The safety lead will classify it within 24 hours and will contact you if anything is unclear.

If anyone is still at risk, call the site emergency number now rather than waiting for this report to be processed.

Safety team

email.name: Serious incident alert
email.subject: SERIOUS INCIDENT - {{site_location}}, {{incident_date}}

email.name: Triage overdue reminder
email.subject: Still unclassified: incident at {{site_location}} on {{incident_date}}
email.body:
This incident report has been waiting more than 24 hours for a severity classification.

Site: {{site_location}} ({{exact_location_on_site}})
Reported by: {{reporter_name}}

Please open the record and complete the triage task today.

email.name: Classified, follow-up under way
email.subject: Your incident report has been classified
email.body:
Hi {{reporter_name}},

Your report about {{site_location}} on {{incident_date}} has been classified as {{severity_classification}}. We are now logging and tracking the follow-up actions.

The report stays open until every action is closed. You will hear from us again when it is signed off.

Safety team

email.name: Closed with no further action
email.subject: Your report has been closed with no further action
email.body:
Hi {{reporter_name}},

Thanks for reporting the event at {{site_location}} on {{incident_date}}. After review, the safety lead has recorded it as not a reportable incident, so no follow-up actions have been raised.

The report is kept on file. If you think that is wrong, reply to this email within 7 days and we will look again.

Safety team

email.name: More detail needed
email.subject: We need a bit more detail on your incident report
email.body:
Hi {{reporter_name}},

Before we can classify your report about {{site_location}} on {{incident_date}}, the safety lead needs more detail. Open your report from the link on your confirmation and update it, or reply to this email.

If we hear nothing within 14 days we will close the report as incomplete.

Safety team

email.name: Closed as incomplete
email.subject: Incident report closed as incomplete
email.body:
Hi {{reporter_name}},

We asked for more detail about the incident at {{site_location}} on {{incident_date}} and have not had a reply in 14 days, so the report has been closed as incomplete. The record is retained.

If the detail is still available, submit a new report and mention this one.

Safety team

email.name: Investigation finished, actions open
email.subject: Investigation complete for the {{site_location}} incident
email.body:
Hi {{reporter_name}},

The investigation into the incident at {{site_location}} on {{incident_date}} is complete. {{total_actions}} follow-up action(s) have been logged and the report stays open until all of them are closed.

Safety team

email.name: Investigation overdue
email.subject: Investigation overdue: {{site_location}}, {{incident_date}}
email.body:
The investigation for this {{severity_classification}} incident at {{site_location}} has been open for more than 72 hours.

Please complete it, record the investigation reference, and log the follow-up actions.

email.name: Weekly open actions reminder
email.subject: Follow-up actions still open: {{site_location}}, {{incident_date}}
email.body:
This incident still has follow-up actions open ({{total_actions}} logged in total).

Chase the owners, mark each action closed with a completion note, then complete the close-out task so the site manager can sign the report off.

email.name: Closure sign-off reminder
email.subject: Sign-off needed: incident at {{site_location}} on {{incident_date}}
email.body:
All follow-up actions for this incident are marked closed and it is waiting for your sign-off.

Review the actions and either approve the closure or send it back with a reason.

email.name: Closure sent back
email.subject: Closure sent back: {{site_location}}, {{incident_date}}
email.body: The site manager has not accepted the closure of this incident. See their reason on the record, reopen or add the actions needed, and resubmit for sign-off.

email.name: Incident closed
email.subject: Incident at {{site_location}} on {{incident_date}} is now closed
email.body:
Hi {{reporter_name}},

All {{total_actions}} follow-up action(s) from your report about {{site_location}} on {{incident_date}} are closed and the site manager has signed the report off.

The full record, including the actions and their completion notes, is retained for ten years in case the insurer or regulator asks for it.

Thanks for reporting it.

Safety team
